mechanism.claim: A shrinkage linear-discriminant classifier fitted only before 2023 can identify broad causal market states whose next 24-hour BTC direction is persistent. Probability tails are traded only during high range-volatility.
mechanism.side: long in frozen upper probability tail; short in frozen lower tail
mechanism.why_distinct: HVDLDA uses a covariance-shrunk generative state classifier, a 24-hour label, and three-hour anchors. HVETCR used nonlinear ExtraTrees and 48-hour labels; HVMRR used six-hour ridge regression on a raw microstructure block. No fitted artifact, threshold, control, or OOS outcome from either is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: range_vol must exceed the calibration-only 60th percentile

training_contract.anchors: every 36 completed 5m bars from fixed position 143
training_contract.label: 1 iff log(open at anchor+1+288/open at anchor+1)>0, else 0
training_contract.fit_rows: complete-label finite-open anchors wholly inside fit window
pipeline: SimpleImputer(strategy='median') fit only on fit rows
StandardScaler fit only on fit rows
training_contract.probability_thresholds: strict empirical 15th and 85th percentiles of positive-class probability on calibration anchors only
training_contract.volatility_threshold: 60th percentile of range_vol on calibration anchors only

oos_clock.decisions: same fixed three-hour anchor schedule from 2023-07-01 onward
oos_clock.eligibility: all ordered features scoreable after fitted median imputation; range_vol >= frozen q60; probability <= frozen q15 or >= frozen q85
oos_clock.entry: anchor completed bar plus one 5m open
oos_clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.historical_market: hash-bound 5m cache through 2026-06-01 plus bound funding/premium auxiliaries
source_plan.oos_execution_prices: sealed until source support and novelty pass

stopping_rule: freeze preregistration, fit/calibrate only before 2023-07, freeze model, then open OOS incidence, novelty, and sequential economics; terminal first failure
